title: Improve analytic models with Oracle Data Science Agent and Azure OpenAI
description:
Learn how to turn simple conversational prompts into highly accurate predictions within a governed, developer-friendly workflow. This session explores building analytics workflows using Oracle Data Science Agent with Oracle Autonomous AI Database on Oracle AI Database@Azure. Gain practical tips on profiling data from Oracle Autonomous AI Database and Azure Blob Storage to uncover patterns, train models, and generate inference-ready SQL using OpenAI-powered Data Science Agent workflows.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
